title: Surface Laptop Copilot+ PC 13" X Plus 16GB/256GB $1497 @ Officeworks
body:
Deal: Surface Laptop Copilot+ PC 13" X Plus 16GB/256GB $1497 @ Officeworks

[WiseBuyer] Do you need subscription for copilot to work?
[Plimsol] A “Copilot+ PC” is Microsoft’s label for the hardware built into the device, specifically an NPU (Neural Processing Unit) that can run AI features locally or offline (apparently it supports more than 20 open-source LLMs now). Copilot has a free tier available, or a paid tier that comes with Office and allows use within office products and has fewer restrictions.
[Churna] Great device, we light game on it (Dota 2, LOL) without issues on medium settings. Extreamly fast chip for everyday tasks and great battery life
[Churna] my bad, We just play DOTA, used League as an example as its similar geraphics but still does work your right
[JoeOz] Do note that it's using an ARM chip, so not your regular x64 chip
[Chmmr] 256gb drives run out quickly. Constantly wiping staff ones at work.
As others have also said, Snapdragon isn't x64, it's ARM64 so it doesn't run everything yet. (I'm looking at you Adobe).
[Erwark] Intentionally small. Get everyone hooked on OneDrive.
[M00Cow] I'm looking at you Adobe
Dear Claude Code, write & compile me an ARM64 version of Adobe <insert app>.
[sackrace] Only if it's your sole storage location. If you're running an external hdd, another desktop device, or a nas (all 3 in my case) then 256gb has only been a compromise in that I only have one game installed at a time.
[Maxdax] Exactly - got it from Microsoft $1647 less $400 Amex offer ( in Aug… I think) for BYOD
[bargaino] Sadly this is not a proper "Surface", but the cut-down entry level formerly known as "go".
Proper one is $2147: https://www.officeworks.com.au/shop/officeworks/p/surface-la…
This lacks the high-def display that Surface is known for. At least Apple puts a decent display on their Neo.
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/979892 - pay 20% more for the macbook maybe? $1747
